card.name: "you" in "Did you know?"
card.fires_on: The word "you" right after "Did" or "did" in "Did you know?" fact-box openers. It also fires weakly on "was" or "were" after a noun in past-tense passive statements.

modes.label: Did you know
modes.description: The word you (any capitalization) right after Did, opening a trivia or fact line.
modes.example: But did<< you>> know that HGH is actually a hormone

modes.label: Past-tense verb after subject
modes.description: Was or were after a subject noun phrase in a past-tense passive statement.
modes.example: The information in this publication<< was>> summarized in easy-to-read format from information

modes.label: Did you find
modes.description: The word find after "Did you" in a feedback question.
modes.example: Did you<< find>> this article helpful? Yes No How

card.writes: It pushes past-time words such as recently, yesterday and originally, and discourages present-time words such as currently and presently.
card.plain: It marks the "you" in "Did you know?" fact boxes, a past-tense question opener.
